## Purpose

Record the provenance and bounded reusable ideas that motivated `BRAND-SYSTEM-SKILL-EXTRACTION-V1`.

This file is reference evidence only.

It does not create Foundation, Pattern, Prompt, Skill, Accepted, runtime, Deploy, Print, Publish, or Promotion authority.

## Borrow / Extract

The following ideas are useful as candidate process concepts when adapted to existing `design-foundation` authority:

- assign each visual reference an explicit permitted role and explicit non-role;
- distinguish a project-local working anchor from repository authority;
- separate localized correction from foundational direction rejection/restart;
- keep rejected visual directions out of later generation inputs unless explicitly re-authorized by a Human project decision with a bounded role;
- record both what must change and what must be preserved during correction;
- validate one representative case before scaling a direction across many assets;
- audit consistency before expanding a generated system.

## Do Not Copy / Do Not Promote

The following source-specific behavior is not adopted as generic repository authority:

- Lovart Agent runtime assumptions;
- provider-specific generation workflows;
- Google Fonts-only constraints;
- credit-consumption approval mechanics;
- packaging-specific workflow stages as universal requirements;
- source benchmark thresholds as repository PASS thresholds;
- any implication that an external approval gate can replace existing Human Gate semantics;
- the full external Skill text or structure as a local runtime Skill.

## Authority boundary

Existing `design-foundation` authority wins on conflict.

In particular:

```text
Reference Intake Borrow / Do Not Copy = PRESERVED
Human Visual Acceptance = PRESERVED
Human Output GO = PRESERVED
Accepted / ACTIVE / runtime semantics = PRESERVED
Foundation / Pattern / Prompt / Skill Promotion = SEPARATE FUTURE DECISION
```

A project-local `Current Project Anchor` is only a working creative reference selected through the existing project direction-selection process.

It is not Human Visual Acceptance, Human Output GO, Accepted Reference, Foundation / Pattern authority, or runtime activation.
